paths.name: Config File
paths.description: Config file for application. Remove this if using environmental variables instead.

variables.name: Immich URL
variables.description: The URL to the Immich Server

variables.name: Immich API Key
variables.description: The API for your Immich server

variables.name: Disable Kiosk UI
variables.description: A shortcut to set KIOSK_SHOW_TIME, KIOSK_SHOW_DATE, KIOSK_SHOW_IMAGE_TIME and KIOSK_SHOW_IMAGE_DATE

variables.name: Show current time
variables.description: Display current time

variables.name: Current time format
variables.description: Display current time in either 12-hour or 24-hour format

variables.name: Show current date
variables.description: Display the current date

variables.name: Current date format
variables.description: The format of the current date. Any GO date string is valid

variables.name: Refresh interval
variables.description: The amount in seconds a image will be displayed for

variables.name: Specific album
variables.description: The ID(s) of a specific album or albums you want to display. See FAQ: How do I set multiple albums? to see how to implement this

variables.name: Specific person
variables.description: The ID(s) of a specific person or people you want to display. See FAQ: How do I set multiple people? to see how to implement this

variables.name: Image fit
variables.description: How your image will fit on the screen. Default is contain. See Image fit for more info

variables.name: Add blurred background
variables.description: Display a blurred version of the image as a background

variables.name: Image transition
variables.description: Which transition to use when changing images

variables.name: Show progress bar
variables.description: Display a progress bar for when image will refresh

variables.name: Show image time
variables.description: Display image time from metadata (if available)

variables.name: Image time format
variables.description: Display image time in either 12-hour or 24-hour format

variables.name: Show image date
variables.description: Display the image date from metadata (if available)

variables.name: Image date format
variables.description: The format of the image date. default is day/month/year. Any GO date string is valid.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: See FAQs for more info. If set, requests must contain the password in the GET parameters e.g. http://192.168.0.123:3000?password=PASSWORD.

variables.name: Cache images
variables.description: Cache selective Immich api calls to reduce unnecessary calls
